# Bundled highlighting assets

Generated by `scripts/update-highlighting.sh`; don't edit by hand.

- Grammars, language definitions and the "2026 Light"/"2026 Dark" themes: VS Code 1.147.0 built-in extensions, MIT (licenses/vscode-LICENSE.txt). Individual grammars carry their upstream origin in their own metadata.
- highlighter.js: vscode-textmate 9.3.2 (MIT) and vscode-oniguruma 2.0.1 (MIT), bundled with tools/highlighting/entry.js.
- onig.wasm: vscode-oniguruma (Oniguruma, BSD; see licenses/vscode-oniguruma-NOTICES.txt).
